applicationOwnership.blocker: No authorized AliExpress Open Platform owner supplied a redacted application-ownership and approval receipt.
applicationOwnership.requiredEvidence: Dated, redacted portal export or screenshot naming the application identifier by hash and showing the owning legal account and approval state.

grantedScopes.blocker: No authenticated application scope or account-limit export is available to this lane.
requiredEvidence: Account-specific quotas, region and program eligibility

exactSkuSnapshot.blocker: No approved application authorization or designated exact SKU was supplied, so no authenticated product read was attempted.
exactSkuSnapshot.requiredEvidence: Redacted response bound to hashed listing and SKU identifiers, with price, currency, inventory, attributes, provider timestamp, request timestamp and response hash.

freightQuote.blocker: No approved application authorization, exact SKU, quantity, origin or redacted destination inputs were supplied.
freightQuote.requiredEvidence: Fresh authenticated quote bound to the exact-SKU snapshot and redacted destination, including service, fee/currency, stock, tracking support and delivery estimate.

authorizedOrderTrackingLifecycle.blocker: No authorized owner confirmed an eligible non-production test facility, and this lane has no authority to place or pay for an order.
authorizedOrderTrackingLifecycle.requiredEvidence: Either a provider-authorized non-production create-detail-tracking lifecycle with redacted identifiers and hashes, or an official account-specific statement that no eligible test facility exists.

idempotencyDriftReconciliation.blocker: Without an authorized lifecycle, duplicate-submit behavior, stale quote drift, tracking transitions and reconciliation outcomes cannot be observed.
requiredEvidence: Stable hashed client correlation and duplicate-submit outcome
Quote-to-order price, currency, stock and freight drift decision
Mismatch reason, operator decision, timestamp and append-only receipt hash

fallback.reconciliation: A human operator must manually compare the approved exact SKU, quantity, price/currency, freight, supplier order reference and each tracking transition; mismatches remain unresolved until a reason and receipt hash are recorded.
fallback.releaseRule: Do not enable SupplierOrderWritePort or direct supplier-to-customer fulfilment from this fixture.
